items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...this is Bill Russell. Do you mind giving your full name? Yeah, my name is John B. Mosley. John B.

ctx.x: He's got several sisters like that. But Remus's wife, she's still in the same place yet. Right in the back of that mosque place. He said, that's Bellwood Street there. Bill.
Bill was playing his snares not too long ago.
